column1: # Putative substrates of the mitotic kinases Plo1 (Polo), Fin1 (NIMA), Ark1 (Aurora) and of Sid2 and Hsk1 in S. pombe: cell-cycle-dependent phosphosites from a SILAC time course of synchronized cells, assigned by kinase consensus; site table collapsed to one row per protein

# Swaffer MP, Jones AW, Flynn HR, Snijders AP, Nurse P. 2018. Quantitative phosphoproteomics reveals the signaling dynamics of cell-cycle kinases in the fission yeast Schizosaccharomyces pombe. Cell Rep 24:503-514. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2018.06.036
# Source: mmc4.xlsx (Table S3, cell-cycle-dependent phosphorylation levels), column "Kinase substrate site" (https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S221112471830946X-mmc4.xlsx)

# Cutoff: the paper's kinase substrate site annotation (Plo1, Fin1, Ark1: phosphosites in the Mitotic or M/G1 cluster that match the kinase consensus; Sid2: Sid2 consensus sites on known Sid2 substrates; Hsk1: G1/S-cluster sites on known Hsk1 targets); Cdc2 sites (a previously defined substrate set) and Orb6 sites left out; 128 sites on 112 proteins, all kept; putative substrates, not validated individually
